import gzip,csv,collections, numpy as np
from scipy.io import mmread
from scipy import sparse
# load labels
features=[]
with gzip.open('filtered_feature_bc_matrix/features.tsv.gz','rt') as f:
    for line in f:
        p=line.rstrip('\\n').split('\\t'); features.append(p[0])
barcodes=[]
with gzip.open('filtered_feature_bc_matrix/barcodes.tsv.gz','rt') as f:
    barcodes=[x.strip() for x in f]
M=mmread('filtered_feature_bc_matrix/matrix.mtx.gz').tocsr()
print('shape',M.shape,'nnz',M.nnz,'dtype',M.dtype)
rows=list(csv.DictReader(open('protospacer_calls_per_cell.csv')))
by={r['cell_barcode']:r['feature_call'] for r in rows}
labels=np.array([by[b] for b in barcodes])
print('barcodes labels missing',sum(x not in by for x in barcodes), 'groups',len(set(labels)))
ref=list(csv.DictReader(open('feature_reference.csv')))
refd={r['id']:r for r in ref}
# group stats raw means, library sizes
for g in sorted(set(labels), key=lambda x:int(x.split('_')[1])):
    ix=np.where(labels==g)[0]
    print(g,refd[g]['target_gene_name'],len(ix),'lib',round(M[:,ix].sum()/len(ix),1),'det',round((M[:,ix].getnnz(axis=0)).mean(),1))
# target genes of interest expression and group means normalized to 10k
names=['IFNG','STAT1','ISG15','IFIT1','IFIT2','IFIT3','MX1','MX2','OAS1','OAS2','OAS3','CXCL10','CXCL11','IRF1','JAK1','JAK2','SOCS1','GBP1','GBP2','GBP5','TAP1','HLA-DRA','HLA-B','B2M','GAPDH','MKI67']
idx={x:i for i,x in enumerate(features)}
print('selected genes present',[(n,idx.get(n)) for n in names])
# normalized matrix; group mean normalized counts
lib=np.asarray(M.sum(axis=0)).ravel(); X=M.multiply(1e4/lib)
order=sorted(set(labels),key=lambda x:int(x.split('_')[1]))
print('gene means norm10k by group')
print('gene\\t'+'\\t'.join(refd[g]['target_gene_name'] for g in order))
for n in names:
    if n in idx:
      vals=[]
      for g in order:
        ix=np.where(labels==g)[0]; vals.append(np.mean(X[idx[n],ix].toarray()))
      print(n+'\\t'+'\\t'.join(f'{v:.2f}' for v in vals))

from scipy.io import mmread
from scipy.stats import mannwhitneyu,ttest_ind

barcodes=[x.strip() for x in gzip.open('filtered_feature_bc_matrix/barcodes.tsv.gz','rt')]

rows=list(csv.DictReader(open('protospacer_calls_per_cell.csv'))); by={r['cell_barcode']:r['feature_call'] for r in rows}; labels=np.array([by[b] for b in barcodes])
refd={r['id']:r for r in csv.DictReader(open('feature_reference.csv'))}
lib=np.asarray(M.sum(axis=0)).ravel(); X=np.log1p(M.multiply(1e4/lib).tocsr())
path=np.arange(20) # curated first 20 IFN genes
score=np.asarray(X[path,:].mean(axis=0)).ravel()
# controls
ctrl=np.isin(labels,[f'guide_{i:03d}' for i in range(1,11)])
print('control n',ctrl.sum(),'score mean median sd',ctrl.sum(),np.mean(score[ctrl]),np.median(score[ctrl]),np.std(score[ctrl]))
print('gene\\tN\\tmean_score\\tmedian\\tmean_delta\\tmedian_delta\\tfrac<ctrlmedian\\tMWp')
for g in sorted(set(labels), key=lambda x:int(x.split('_')[1])):
 if ctrl[np.where(labels==g)[0]].all(): continue
 ix=labels==g; vals=score[ix]
 stat,p=mannwhitneyu(vals,score[ctrl],alternative='less')
 print(f\"{refd[g]['target_gene_name']}\\t{ix.sum()}\\t{vals.mean():.4f}\\t{np.median(vals):.4f}\\t{vals.mean()-score[ctrl].mean():.4f}\\t{np.median(vals)-np.median(score[ctrl]):.4f}\\t{np.mean(vals<np.median(score[ctrl])):.2f}\\t{p:.2e}\")
# ranks all target by score
print('\\nSorted low:')
for g in sorted([x for x in set(labels) if not x.startswith('guide_00') or int(x.split('_')[1])>10],key=lambda x: np.mean(score[labels==x])):
    print(refd[g]['target_gene_name'],labels.tolist().count(g),np.mean(score[labels==g]))

import gzip,csv,numpy as np
from scipy.io import mmread
M=mmread('filtered_feature_bc_matrix/matrix.mtx.gz').tocsr(); b=[x.strip() for x in gzip.open('filtered_feature_bc_matrix/barcodes.tsv.gz','rt')]; lab=np.array([{r['cell_barcode']:r['feature_call'] for r in csv.DictReader(open('protospacer_calls_per_cell.csv'))}[x] for x in b]); refd={r['id']:r for r in csv.DictReader(open('feature_reference.csv'))}; ctrl=np.isin(lab,[f'guide_{i:03d}' for i in range(1,11)]); lib=np.asarray(M.sum(axis=0)).ravel(); X=M.multiply(1e4/lib).tocsr(); C=np.asarray(X[:20,ctrl].mean(axis=1)).ravel()+1e-8
out=[]
for g in sorted(set(lab),key=lambda x:int(x.split('_')[1])):

for x in sorted(out): print(f'medLFC {x[0]:.3f} mean {x[1]:.3f} <-0.5 {x[2]} <-1 {x[3]} {x[5]} n{x[6]}')
